subject.title: fix: prevent repeated tool-call IDs from poisoning sessions

question: Should the agent-runtime owners accept dropping an ambiguous displaced repeated-ID result rather than guessing which assistant-turn occurrence owns it?
rationale: The code deliberately trades preservation of ambiguous historical output for structural validity and avoidance of cross-turn result misattribution; that replay policy cannot be selected from tests alone.

options.title: Accept conservative ambiguity handling
options.body: Keep the proposed rule: attach displaced output only to a uniquely resolvable occurrence and synthesize a safe missing result otherwise.

options.title: Require a different attribution contract
options.body: Pause this PR and specify a provider- or transcript-level ownership rule before changing repair behavior for ambiguous historical records.

recommendation.title: Accept conservative ambiguity handling
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed rule: attach displaced output only to a uniquely resolvable occurrence and synthesize a safe missing result otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership of displaced-result indexing and transcript-repair changes makes this the closest feature-history routing candidate.
